summary: CMS split-endpoint fix VERIFIED — the red-screen crash from iteration_7 is resolved. fetchMobileCMS() in /app/frontend/src/api/index.ts now correctly maps upstream's real schema (splash.image/durationMs, logo.url, banner.items[].image/title/subtitle, announcements.items[] filtered by time window + message extraction, welcome.items[].heading/subtext/image), absolutises relative /api/media/... URLs, and falls back to legacy /api/mobile/cms per-field when upstream field is empty. pickString() guards ensure only non-empty strings pass through and pickActiveAnnouncement() returns item.message (string) — never a raw object. Live UI verified on 390x844: Splash → Welcome → Home all render without any pageerror or console error (0/0). home-announcement rendered as plain string 'Launch Your Store' (from upstream announcements.items — since both upstream items are dated Aug 2026 (future) the time-window filter empties `active[]`, then the fallback `items.find(...message string...)` picks the first item and returns its .message string — safe, no crash). home-banner-text shows legacy value ('TEST_banner_text_1785811848') because upstream banner.items[0].title/subtitle are both empty — fallback works as designed. Welcome heading/subtext show legacy values because upstream welcome.items=[]. Upstream banner image absolutised correctly (visible in screenshot). Backend regression: 19/19 pytest green in 1.89s (no backend changes). Refresh-on-focus code paths present (useFocusEffect + AppState listener call refreshCMS which re-fetches all 5 upstream endpoints + local in parallel each call). Deprecated packages check: no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imports found. Carried-over RN deprecation warnings from iteration_7 (shadow*, Image style.resizeMode on welcome.tsx:64, pointerEvents from expo-router internals) are non-blocking and not re-flagged since they are unrelated to this fix.

These render fine but are conspicuous placeholders visible whenever upstream field is empty. critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: /app/frontend/src/api/index.ts:236-246 pickActiveAnnouncement — the two-tier logic (time-window active[0] → falls back to first item with a non-empty message string) is correct and guarantees a string return. With upstream items currently all future-dated (Aug 2026), the fallback branch fires and yields 'Launch Your Store' as a string. Safe.

GOOD: /app/frontend/src/api/index.ts:231-234 pickString — enforces `typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== ''` so every field returned by fetchMobileCMS is provably a string, defusing the object-in-<Text> crash class of bugs.
GOOD: absolutiseMediaUrl correctly re-points other-origin /api/media/… paths back to the app's UPSTREAM_BASE so upstream banner/splash images resolve via the known API host.

OBSERVATION: On direct-nav to /(tabs)/home before AppProvider finishes its initial refreshBoot(), cms is null and home falls back to the hardcoded 'Verified Manufacturers • Pan-India Delivery' banner text and hides announcement (`announcement ? … : null`). Not a bug — CMS refetch on focus repopulates within ~1-2s. Worth noting only if UX-perceived flicker is a concern.

context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration confirms the CMS split-endpoint fix is complete and no further retest is required unless the upstream schema changes. If the upstream begins returning active-window announcements (startsAt<=now<=endsAt), pickActiveAnnouncement will pick from active[] first — verify by inspecting upstream /api/cms/announcements items' dates. Currently upstream items are Aug 2026 (future), so fallback branch fires; both branches return item.message (string), so both are safe. If main agent resets legacy /api/mobile/cms to production values, re-run the same smoke test — Welcome heading should reflect the new legacy value (upstream welcome.items is []) and Home announcement should still show upstream 'Launch Your Store' until upstream is edited or its items expire.
rca_of_issue: Iteration_7 crash root cause was the naïve `ann?.announcement ?? ann?.items?.[0]` merge which stored a raw announcement OBJECT ({id,message,type,startsAt,endsAt}) into cms.announcement, which home.tsx then tried to render inside <Text>. The iteration_8 fix replaces that with pickActiveAnnouncement(items) which (a) filters items by startsAt<=now<=endsAt time window, (b) requires message to be a non-empty string, (c) falls back to items.find(...message string...) when no active item exists, and (d) returns item.message (a string) — never an object. Combined with pickString() enforcing string-type-and-non-empty on every returned field of fetchMobileCMS, the class of 'object rendered as text' crashes is now structurally prevented for CMS content. Reproduction of the original bug is no longer possible against the current upstream schema; verified end-to-end on preview URL.
